title: Partition of Bengal reshapes political alignments
detail: The partition of Bengal altered provincial politics and intensified debates over representation, administration, and communal interests.

title: Simla Deputation presses for Muslim political safeguards
detail: A delegation of Muslim leaders met the Viceroy and advanced demands for protected political representation within constitutional reforms.

title: All-India Muslim League founded in Dhaka
detail: At Dhaka, leaders formally established the League as an all-India organization to pursue Muslim political interests through constitutional methods.

title: Organizational consolidation and constitutional lobbying
detail: The new party developed leadership networks and policy positions around electoral representation and constitutional reform.

title: League politics influences partition-era state formation
detail: Over subsequent decades, the League became a major actor in all-India negotiations, deeply affecting Bengal and the eventual partition settlement.
